statement: Mus never writes tasks events or plans without user confirmation
FIXED and PROTECTED blocks are not auto-moved
Do not fill every free minute; respect daily_plans capacity
A task without start/end is not an event; do not invent a clock time
ANYTIME items stay off the timeline unless the user asks
Place FIXED events before fitting FLEXIBLE tasks
Do not schedule a task before its unfinished prerequisites
If work exceeds usable open time say so and propose deferrals
Replan remaining day never rewrites completed history
Planner must not change calorie floors or logged food numbers
Energy and mood flags are not medical diagnoses
No cheat guilty earned or failed language; use Released for goals set down
User edits always win over a proposal
Every planner LLM call uses a Zod schema
Prefer historical session length over the user's optimistic estimate
Rain may suggest moving outdoor items; user chooses
Do not abut distant locations without a travel block
Meal-aware suggestions only if food planning is enabled
